data.name: Bertina
data.gender_notes: Bertina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements berht (bright) and tin (shining, radiant). The name Bertina represents a person who is bright and shining in her actions and demeanor. The name Bertina carries the meaning “Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bertina usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the inner light and radiance of one's soul.
data.etymology: Bertina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bertina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: ברטינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ברטינה היא שם נוצרי שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו 'נושאת אור' או 'מאירה'. השם קשור לכבוד אלוהים ולתפקידו של המאמין כנושא אור לעולם. השם ברטינה מורכב משני שמות גרמניים: 'ברת' שמשמעותו 'בהיר' ו-'ינה' שמשמעותו 'אור'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים בגרמניה ובמדינות אחרות באירופה.

in_greek.name: Βερτίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Βερτίνα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'φέγουσα φως' ή 'λαμπρή'. Το όνομα συνδέεται με τη δόξα του Θεού και τον ρόλο του πιστού ως φορέα φωτός στον κόσμο. Το όνομα Βερτίνα αποτελείται από δύο γερμανικά ονόματα: 'Βερθ' που σημαίνει 'λαμπρός' και 'Ινα' που σημαίνει 'φως'. Το όνομα βρίσκεται σε χρήση μεταξύ των χριστιανών στη Γερμανία και σε άλλες χώρες της Ευρώπης.

in_latin.name: Bertina
in_latin.meaning: she who brings light, shining, glory of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Bertina is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'she who brings light' or 'shining'. The name is associated with the glory of God and the role of the believer as a bearer of light in the world. The name Bertina is composed of two Germanic elements: 'bert' meaning 'bright' and 'ina' meaning 'light'. The name has been in use among Christians in Germany and other European countries.

in_english.name: Bertina
in_english.long_meaning: Bertina is a Christian name of Germanic origin, meaning 'bright' or 'shining'. It is associated with the glory of God and the role of the believer as a light-bearer in the world. The name is derived from the Germanic elements 'bert' meaning 'bright' and 'ina' meaning 'light'. Bertina has been used among Christians in Germany and other European countries, symbolizing spiritual illumination and devotion to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bertina carries a sense of dignity and nobility, originating in the Germanic tradition. As many prominent historical figures, such as Germanic princesses and early Christian saints, share the name, Bertina continues to evoke a strong and graceful image.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Bertina is associated with the radiance and brightness of spiritual life. As it is derived from the Old High German 'berht', meaning 'bright' or 'shining', Bertina reflects a pure and shining spiritual essence. Additionally, the name evokes light and hope, reminding us to strive for continuous self-improvement in our faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bertina: Bright and Serene, carrying the light of God within, in the stillness of her being, she illuminates the way for others.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bertina of Saxony (d. 1154) was a German abbess and a member of the noble House of Wettin. The name Bertina carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bertina remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Bertina from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Bertina - "Bright, shining". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
